newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Belgian public sector workers give strike warning.
newsitem.headline: Belgian public sector workers give strike warning.

text.p: Belgium's ACOD/CGSP socialist public sector workers' union warned the government on Friday it would strike before the end of October unless planned pension reforms were revised.

The government on Tuesday proposed to roll back some pension benefits and raise the retirement age of women as part of budget cuts designed to clean up public finances ahead of the final stage of European economic and monetary union (EMU).
A union spokesman said talks with Belgium's two other public sector workers' unions were planned for October 14 to consider the possibility of a combined action.
"We in any case are saying we will strike unless the government changes its position," he said.
"The union is now calling on its members and activists to mobilise and prepare for action."
